title: Mitti De Baway Episode 1 Recap (Roman Arabic)
language: Roman Arabic - Egyptian/White Dialect (Pure Latin Letters)
elevenlabs_notes: Generate 8 separate MP3 files (part1.mp3 through part8.mp3) by pasting each part's spoken_text into ElevenLabs. Drop them into elevenlabs_audio/ and run merge_audio.bat.

parts.label: PART 1 (00:00 - 01:00)
parts.spoken_text: Fi set labsa eswed fi eswed, sayma siyam nedr w mestaneya khabar moot ragel wahed bas. W fi nafs el lahza di, el ragel da beyokhrog men el segn w kol el masageen beyeheyooh kaeno malek mesh mogrem. Laken awel ma yewsal el maqaber, el rasas beyenzil aaleeh zay el matar. Meen el set di, w meen el ragel da, w leeh el hob el qadeem ethawel li aadaawa kolaha dam? Hekayetna el naharda men mosalsal Mitti De Baway, fi ard el Punjab elli mesh bas betezraa el khair, di kaman betezraa qesas hob aazema w qesas enteqam ma betenteheesh abadan. Hena el hob aw el korh, el etneen beyetamelou men el qalb b kol sedq. El qesa betebda sanat alf tisaamiya tisaa w tiseen. Gowa mamarrat el segn el modlema, ragel b daqn w galabeya soda beyemshi b thabat ghareeb. Da Iqbal Channan, elli el nas kolaha betkhaf men esmo w betnadeeh Baala.

parts.label: PART 2 (01:00 - 02:00)
parts.spoken_text: El masageen wara el qodban beyehatfou b esm Baala w beyodroboo aala el hadeed kaeno batal qawmi khareg men el harb. W fi nafs el waqt, el mashhad beyenqelna li makan tani khales, le Bilqees Bano, elli zaman kan esmaha Billo. Labsa eswed b el kamel gowa el maqam betaaaha, rafaa edeiha b tadaraa w hawalaiha setat keteer beyesmaou kalamha b ehteram w khashya. Nergaa tani lel segn, el bawaba el hadeed el teqeela betetfeteh w Baala beyokhrog lel noor. Barrah beyelaqi akhooh el soghayar Jooji w reggalto mestaneyeeno b el ahdan w el farah. Laken badal ma yerouh beito, Baala beyemshi aala tool aala el maqaber, beyoshosh mayya aala qabr ahlo w beyerfaa eedo yeqra el fatiha. W fi nafs el waqt, el khadama betgeeb el akl le Billo, fa betqolaha b broud shadid, rageei el akl da, ana sayma siyam nedr, w mesh haftar gheir lamma el nedr betaaie yetehaqqaq.

parts.label: PART 3 (02:00 - 03:00)
parts.spoken_text: W Baala lissa waqef odam el qabr beyedee b kol khoshoo, el hodoo betaa el maqaber beyetqeleb fagaah li sahat harb haqiqiya. Reggala mosallaheen beyotlaou fagaah men wara el qoboor el qadeema w beyewaggeo benadeq el kalashnikov aala Baala mobasharatan. Baala beyesrakh fi Jooji b aala soto w yeqolo ehreb men hena besoraa, laken el akh el wafi beyerfod yeseeb akhooh el kebeer lewahdo f el khatar. El nar betetfeteh men kol etegah w soot el rasas beyemla el sama w beyehaz el ard. Fi nafs el thaneya di, Billo betokhrog toqaf barrah el maqam el abyad b sokoon moreeb, w fi aeineiha nazra barda ma feehash la khof wala rahma. Gowa el maqaber, el rasas beyeseeb Jooji w beyoqaa aala el ard gharaqan fi dammo, w baadaha Baala nafso beyetdarab w beyoqaa aala wesho f el torab. W henak odam el maqam, Billo betghammad aeineiha b raha ghareeba, kaen el dam elli saal f el maqaber kan egaba le doaaaha men seneen taweela.

parts.label: PART 4 (03:00 - 04:00)
parts.spoken_text: El kamira betetlaa fooq el maqaber el hadya w betergaa bina seneen keteera lewara f el madi, qabl el segn w qabl el selah w qabl kol el dam w el enteqam da. Hena benshoof Iqbal Channan el haqiqi qabl ma yebqa Baala el ragel el mokheef, tager qomash tayeb w mohtaram beyeshtaghal b aaraq gabeeno aashan yebni hayat hadea w sharifa. Akhooh el soghayar Jooji shab tayesh w dammo khafeef beyerakab el motosikl b farha w beyesaed akhooh f kol shoghl el mahal. F el beit, merato Zareena elli bethebbo geddan betfakaro b waado el qadeem enno yegiblaha ghawayesh dahab arbaa tola kamleen. Iqbal beyerod aaleiha b hodoo w haniya enno awel ma yekhalas gawaz okhto Kausar hayeamilaha el ghawayesh maaa shabket okhto. Lamma Zareena betezal shwaya, Iqbal beyefahimha b kol saraaha enno mesh bas gozha, howa el ab w el om le ekhwato, w kol kheir howa feeh el naharda sababo waqfet ekhwato ganbo tool aomro.

parts.label: PART 5 (04:00 - 05:00)
parts.spoken_text: Baad keda benshoof Iqbal w Jooji gowa mahal el qomash el zahma, w fagaah beyedkhol aaleihom baltagiya men el mantaqa talbeen felous zyada men gheir haq. Jooji beyetganen w beyesrakh feehom enno kol awwel shahr el etaawa betewsalhom kamla men gheir taakheer, f leeh gayeen delwaqti yaklou taab gheirhom b el haram w el baltaga? El kalam beyekbar w el khinaqa beteqarab men el darb, w el baltagiya beyehaddedoo Jooji b kol waqaha. Laken Iqbal beyedkhol f el noss b aql w hodoo shadid, beyebed akhooh w beyekallem kebeer el baltagiya b ehteram aashan yenhi el moshkela qabl ma tekbar. Baad ma yemshou, Jooji beyetadeq enno akhooh zaalo odamhom, fa Iqbal beyeqolo gomla hatetradad f balna tool el qesa, ehna aadeen hena aashan netager mesh aashan naamel baltaga, warana gawaz Kausar w el hag el sana el gayya w ma yenfaash naadi had. Ya tara eih elli hayehawel el ragel el mosalem da li akhtar mogrem f el Punjab?

parts.label: PART 6 (05:00 - 06:00)
parts.spoken_text: Barrah f el sharee, fagaah el hara kolaha betetqeleb lamma mawkeb arabeyat beida kebeer beyewsal odam qasr aaelet el Shah el ghaniya. El setat f el shawaree beyegrou yeshofou meen elli gah, w beyetlaa enno el sheikh el mashhoor Wadde Sarkar zaar beit el Shah elli homma men aham w aqdam morideenoh. Gowa beit Iqbal, Iqbal beyergaa mel shoghl taaban w beyetassab aala ebno el soghayar Ibrahim aashan beyesmaa aghani, leanno dayman khayef el nas taayro b madi aaeleto el qadeem f el ghona w el tarab. Zareena betedhak w betqool enno Ibrahim talee aaneed zay aammo Jooji b el zabt, w kanet tetmanna takhdo men wedno le Wadde Sarkar yeqra aaleeh w yebareklo. W gowa qasr el Shah, Wadde Sarkar beyemdah merat ebn el Shah el gedida aala taqwaha w ebadetha, w beyehazarha enno elli beyemshi f el tareeq da beyewageh ekhtebarat saaba geddan, laken lazem tesbot aashan el ekhtebarat di hatkhaleeha dahab safi.

parts.label: PART 7 (06:00 - 07:00)
parts.spoken_text: El kalam el basiit da hayeqleb hayat Iqbal ras aala aaqab baad daqayeq waheda bas men gheir ma yehses. Gowa hosh beit Iqbal, Zareena betehki b hamas enno Wadde Sarkar edda baraka khasa le aarouset beit el Shah, el set el saleha elli kol banat el mantaqa beyerouhou yetalemou minha el Quran kol youm. Iqbal kan samee w mesh markez abadan, laken fagaah Zareena betentaq el esm elli beyewaqaf qalbo f thaneya, Bilqees, Bilqees Bano elli gat aarousa men Wazirabad le beit el Shah. Awel ma yesmaa el esm, wesh Iqbal beyesfar w eedo betewqaf f el hawa kaen el zaman weqef. Beyeqoom men gheir ma yakol wala loqma w beyokhrog men el beit sakt, w Zareena waqfa mesh fahma eih elli hasal. Iqbal beyemshi dayekh f el shawaree el qadeema lehad ma yelmaa set labsa shaal abyad dakhlah bawabet beit el Shah. Beyewqaf metsammar w beyebos aala el shebbak, henak waqfa Bilqees elli wogoudha lesa beyehaz kayano.

parts.label: PART 8 (07:00 - 08:00)
parts.spoken_text: Laken el mofagaa el akbar w el asdam kanet lissa mestaneyana gowa qasr el Shah. Nazeer Shah, goz Bilqees, aaeed sakt w sharid lamma bent men el aaila betesaalo b kol baraaa, bokra aeed gawazkom ya Nazeer, ya tara hatgeeb eih hedia helwa le meratak? Wesh Nazeer beyetqeleb f lahza w beyerod aaleiha b ghadab maktoum w soot bared, enti ma baqeeteesh tefla soghayara, w aarfa kwayes enno nafs youm aeed gawazna howa youm zekra wafat akhou Bilqees. El gomla di betefaggar alf soaal w betorbot kol el kheyout b baad, hob mamnoo, sharaf magrouh, w dam aomro ma etnasa. B el leil, Iqbal beyergaa beito b hodoo, beyebos aala merato w ebno el naymeen, w beyetlaa el balakona f el dalma wahdo. Zekrayat Wazirabad betehgem aaleeh, dehk Billo w Baala zaman qabl el firaq w el nar elli fi aeineeh delwaqti. Eih serr qatl akhou Bilqees w ezzay el hob da wesselhom lel maqaber? Estannou el halaqa el gayya. [end]
